research.summary: Automated Lane Centering (ALC) systems are critical components of Level 2 autonomous vehicles, yet their reliance on Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) for lane detection introduces security vulnerabilities. research.summary: The rapid expansion of the Internet of Things (IoT) has introduced complex and evolving cybersecurity challenges. This paper presents a Large Language Model (LLM)-based framework for intelligent threat detection and prevention in IoT networks. research.summary: Agent skills extend LLM agents with privileged third-party capabilities such as filesystem access, credentials, network calls, and shell execution. Existing safety work catches malicious prompts and risky runtime actions, but the skill artifact itself goes unverified.
